required_first_test.name: zero_aligned_first
assertions: test_zero_aligned_first is invoked directly, not through mi_run_on_thread
mi_malloc_aligned(0, 16) is the first engine allocation on the creating thread
both zero-size aligned allocations are non-null and satisfy their alignment
the helper frees both returned blocks

required_init_assertions: crabc_test_init() is the only adapter operation before the first CHECK
a nonzero init result prints a diagnostic and returns failure
no selected test runs without successful initialization
required_summary_assertions: print_test_summary() runs exactly once before shutdown
the upstream succeeded/failed summary remains on stdout/stderr as emitted by testhelper.h
any upstream CHECK failure contributes to the process failure result
required_shutdown_assertions: crabc_test_shutdown() runs after the upstream summary
shutdown must return zero for fixture success
a nonzero shutdown result is printed and makes main return failure
main returns failure when either upstream checks or shutdown fails

compile_requirements.compiler: musl-gcc from the pinned Linux/AArch64 container
compile_requirements.link_order: fixture object, adapter staticlib, then musl/system libraries
compile_requirements.notes: The fixture is source-only provenance: do not check in an extracted or copied C fork. Build the staticlib for the pinned musl AArch64 target before linking. The pinned musl-gcc specs replace the normal library search list, so /usr/lib is named explicitly to resolve Alpine's libgcc_s linker script while retaining rustc's exact native-static-libs order.

verification.header_compile_note: The patched source passed host C11 syntax compilation with the concurrently built adapter header and pinned include tree; the pinned Docker musl/AArch64 build remains the runner's execution boundary.
